entities.summary: Lucas Sundberg Sims is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Chicago White Sox of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Atlanta Braves, Cincinnati Reds, Boston Red Sox, and Washington Nationals. He made his MLB debut in 2017.
